warnings: Wall quantities sum individual straight uniform walls; no wall-join overlap or material-layer deductions.
Door Width/Height describe the overall wall opening, not leaf size or clear passage; geometry is a generic three-bar frame.
Slabs keep their full volume; explicit Slab priorities deduct intersections only from joined Columns/Beams. Other intersections are not deducted.
Window Width/Height describe the overall opening; the four-bar frame has no pane, leaf or operation.
4 native datum object(s) are listed as reference and omitted from IFC.
7 native drawing definition(s) are references with a separate drawing revision and omitted from IFC.
10 native schedule definition(s) are references with a separate schedule revision and omitted from IFC.

Native material rows partition assigned product solids only; legacy text materials remain unassigned. Consult material_totals for assignment coverage; do not add material rows again to product quantities.
